product_brief: A software library that provides cryptographic functionality to the Go standard library and other Go applications.
pqc_capability_description: The module implements ML-KEM (FIPS 203) with parameter sets ML-KEM-1024 and ML-KEM-768, supporting Encapsulation and Decapsulation functions. It is FIPS 140-3 validated (Certificate #5325) with an active status.
crypto_primitives: AES-CBC, AES-CMAC, AES-CTR, AES-GCM, Counter DRBG, cSHAKE-128, cSHAKE-256, Deterministic ECDSA, ECDSA, EDDSA (Ed25519), HMAC DRBG, HMAC-SHA2, HMAC-SHA3, KAS-ECC-SSC, KDA HKDF, KDF SP800-108, KDF SSH, KTS-IFC, ML-KEM, PBKDF, RSA, SHA2, SHA3, SHAKE, TLS KDF
fips_validated: Yes, FIPS 140-3 Level 1, Certificate #5325, Status Active, Sunset Date 4/26/2031
primary_platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Alpine Linux, Amazon Linux, Oracle Linux, SUSE Linux Enterprise Server, Ubuntu, Debian, FreeBSD, Microsoft Windows, Apple macOS, Google Cloud, AWS EC2, HPE hardware
signature_schemes: ECDSA (P-224, P-256, P-384, P-521), EDDSA (Ed25519), RSA (PKCS1v1.5, PSS)
testing_&_validation_methods: CAVP Cert A6650; Pre-Operational Self-Tests, Conditional Self-Tests, Periodic Self-Tests; Integrity Test via HMAC-SHA2-256
